title: Interviews with quotes you can check
description: Marking the important moments, checking the words and exporting fragments with the speakers and the time.

blocks.text: The interviewer marks the important moments, then gathers the fragments with the speakers’ names and their own comments. Tapping a quote takes you back to the audio, and a short step backwards helps you hear the context.

quote.text: It helps me find the quotes and information in the interview that I need faster than skipping around in a recording or simply taking notes where I mark certain time stamps.

blocks.text: From a conversation to the quotes you picked

A useful first version keeps the time and the speaker together with the excerpt you picked when it exports. Wording changed by an editor has to be distinguishable from the machine transcript; the exact words are checked by listening.

This is a separate workflow where navigation and checking matter more than a summary of the whole interview. What is worth measuring is the time it takes to prepare a few quotes that actually get used, including checking them, not just how fast the text appears.
